subject: OpenCrates request: community credits for CI + demos
messages:
From: Alex Soto <alex@opencrates.org>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 10:23:00 -0800
Subject: Request: community credits for OpenCrates CI (OSS maintainer)

Hi Karthik,

I'm Alex, one of the maintainers at OpenCrates (https://github.com/opencrates). We're an open-source package registry used by lots of small projects and many incubators. We've been testing Redwood during onboarding and our CI and public demo pages rely on generation for README snippets, automated changelog notes, and a small public demo that showcases package recommendations.

We exhausted the free trial quota tied to our account (opencrates@github) while validating performance. Would Redwood consider providing community/free credits for maintainers so we can keep CI and demos running? Rough numbers: ~200k tokens/month across CI + demo, roughly 1-2M tokens burst when we run full integration tests. We don't have a procurement contract — this would be a community grant to support ongoing maintenance and public demos.

Relevant links: https://github.com/opencrates (MIT), maintainer list: 7 people.

Happy to provide repo access, org links, or a short CLA if needed. What's the process for OSS credits or a self-serve promo we can redeem?

Thanks,
Alex Soto
OpenCrates Maintainer
attachments: project-license.txt (text)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Alex Soto <alex@opencrates.org>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: community credits for OpenCrates CI (OSS maintainer)

Hi Alex — thanks for the notes and the GitHub link. Really appreciate the detail. We do have a community grants program for open-source maintainers and a self-serve flow for standard grants. A few quick clarifying questions so I can route this correctly:

- GitHub org URL (you included the main link, can you confirm the org slug?)
- License (you mentioned MIT — please confirm there are no proprietary modules)
- Number of active maintainers and whether the demo is public-facing (yes/no)
- Requested monthly credit amount (typical community credits are $1k/month; anything above $2k requires manager approval)

If OpenCrates fits the standard criteria I can approve a $1,000/month community grant immediately and issue a self-serve redemption link. If you're asking for $1,500/month (or higher) I'll need a quick manager sign-off — not a full legal review, just a policy approval.

I'll attach the OSS grants policy for transparency: https://drive.google.com/open?id=policy_oss_grants_2026 (attached: opensrc-policy-20260212.pdf)

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Alex Soto <alex@opencrates.org>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: community credits for OpenCrates CI (OSS maintainer)

Thanks Karthik — answers below: 

- Org slug: github.com/opencrates (org: opencrates)
- License: MIT for core registry and public demo; some optional tooling in a separate repo is Apache 2.0
- Active maintainers: 7 (3 full-time across two companies, 4 volunteers)
- Public demo: yes, hosted at https://play.opencrates.org
- Requested credit: $1,500/month for 6 months to cover CI + demo spikes

Billing / account: we used opencrates@github (no paid contract). If you need a billing id we can create one.

Let me know if we should kick off any quick verification steps — happy to share repo invite.

Appreciate the help,
Alex

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: OpenCrates request: community credits for CI + demos — approval needed

Marissa / Vivek / Connor — forwarding an OSS credits request. Summary: OpenCrates (MIT) — 7 maintainers, public demo, ~200k tokens/month steady with 1-2M token bursts. External asks for $1,500/month for 6 months.

I can approve $1k/month via self-serve under the standard OSS grant policy, but anything >$2k/month requires exec sign-off. This is $1.5k — cross-checking with policy: fits community intent, public product, no red flags on licensing. Requesting sign-off to provide $1,500/month for six months. If approved I'll provision a redeemable grant code and include usage limits/alerts.

Attached: opensrc-policy-20260212.pdf

Thanks,
Karthik

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: OpenCrates request: community credits for CI + demos — approval needed

Karthik — approved.

Approve $1,500/month for 6 months for OpenCrates (deal id OSS-2026-1423). Conditions:
- Require monthly usage summary from maintainers (quick screenshot of account usage or a short weekly digest)
- Add an audit clause in notes: grant can be revoked if we detect commercial resale or misuse
- Inform security (Vivek cc'd) to flag any unusual token exfiltration patterns; they can request additional telemetry if needed

Connor, please add a note in the account: "Community grant: $1,500/mo for 6 months, starts on 2026-02-14, monitoring enabled."

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Alex Soto <alex@opencrates.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Approved: OpenCrates community credits (1,500/mo for 6 months)

Hi Alex — good news. We've approved a community grant for OpenCrates: $1,500/month for 6 months (OSS-2026-1423). The credits will be added to the account tied to opencrates@github once you confirm the exact account/billing id to apply to.

What we're provisioning now:
- $1,500 USD credit applied monthly for 6 months, starting today (2026-02-14)
- Usage alerts configured at 50% and 90% of the monthly credit
- Audit clause noted; we'll request a short monthly usage summary (one screenshot or summary line is fine)

Redeem: use the self-serve portal link below and enter the grant code contained in the attached CSV. If you'd rather we apply directly, reply with the billing account id and we'll apply it on our side.

Redeem link: https://console.redwood.ai/redeem?grant=OSS-20260214-1423
Attachment: oss-credits-grant-20260214.csv (contains one-time grant code and quick steps)

Please confirm which flow you prefer (self-redeem vs. we-apply). Congrats — excited to support OpenCrates.

—Karthik
